blocks.x: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally Driisti Smart Vision Glasses is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
For Driisti Smart Vision Glasses architecture, the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate:

items: regime mapping to controls and owners
golden datasets, judge panels, red teams
PII, injection, topic fences as code

blocks.x: For Driisti Smart Vision Glasses, instrumented from week one, on your channels:

Runtime dependencies: MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Driisti Smart Vision Glasses follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Talk to the team that runs Driisti Smart Vision Glasses architecture in production — the briefing is technical by design, and the first one costs nothing but the hour.
